editorial: When the city’s underbelly erupts under a new tyrant, you’re invited to feel its pulse. Its raw depiction of leadership shift among gangs crafts a symphony of violence without constant exposition. The cinematographer uses low-angle shots and natural street lighting to make every alley feel both claustrophobic and expansive. You’re a fan of character-driven crime dramas that embrace nihilistic realism.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of crime dramas who enjoy immersive, high-intensity narratives.
